title: Český Krumlov Day Trip from Prague
short_description: A castle town in a bend of the Vltava, in one day and in your own Mercedes. Door to door from your Prague address, with your chauffeur waiting while you explore and one price for the whole car.
description:
Český Krumlov is the day trip visitors to Prague ask for most. The whole old town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site: a castle with a painted tower above a tight bend of the Vltava, lanes of Renaissance houses below it, and one of the best-preserved Baroque theatres in Europe.

It is also a long way for a train, with a fixed timetable and a change on the way. By private car it is one seat from your hotel door to the edge of the old town. You leave when you choose and come back when you have seen enough.

Your chauffeur collects you at your address in Prague and drives you south through Bohemia. A start in the morning puts you in Český Krumlov before the tour coaches fill the lanes. The centre is closed to cars, so your chauffeur drops you at the car park by the old town, a few minutes’ walk from the main square, and waits there for the time included in your booking. The included time is shown next to the price, and you can add extra hours when you book.

The price is for the whole car, not per person. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and your time in Český Krumlov. You see the total before you pay. Time beyond your booking on the day is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it.

Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a guide. Entrance tickets, guided tours and meals are not included. If you would like a licensed local guide, book one for the hours you plan to be there and we will help you time the day around it.
highlights: The castle and its painted round tower above the Vltava, the second largest castle in the Czech Republic
The old town on foot: Renaissance houses, bridges and the river bend
A Baroque castle theatre that is among the best preserved in Europe
Leave early and arrive before the tour coaches
River terraces below the castle for lunch
One seat from your hotel door, with no train timetable and no change

itinerary.title: Early pickup at your Prague address
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur meets you at the door of your hotel or apartment in Prague at the time you chose. An early start is worth it: the lanes are quiet in the morning.

itinerary.title: Drive south through Bohemia
itinerary.body: The route leaves Prague by motorway and continues through the hills and fields of South Bohemia. It is a long drive, so settle in and enjoy the countryside.

itinerary.title: Arrival by the old town
itinerary.body: The centre is closed to cars. Your chauffeur drops you at the car park by the old town, a few minutes’ walk from the main square, and tells you where the car will wait.

itinerary.title: The castle and its tower
itinerary.body: Walk up to the castle. The courtyards and gardens are free to walk; the tower, the interiors and the Baroque theatre need tickets, which you book yourself.

itinerary.title: The old town and a long lunch
itinerary.body: Cross the river, wander the lanes and find lunch on the river terraces below the castle. In July and August reserve a table, or eat a little early.

itinerary.title: Back to the car
itinerary.body: Call or message your chauffeur when you are ready. The car is waiting where you were dropped off.

itinerary.title: Return to your Prague address
itinerary.body: The same car and chauffeur bring you back to the same address in Prague where the day began.

includes: A private Mercedes with your own chauffeur, for your party only
Pickup and return at your address in Prague
The drive to Český Krumlov and back
Waiting time at the destination for the hours included in your booking
Child seats at no charge: tell us the children’s ages when you book
One price for the whole car, shown in full before you pay
excludes: Entrance tickets for the castle, the tower and the theatre
A guide or a guided tour: your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide
Extra hours beyond your booking, unless you add them when you book
pickup_info: Pickup and return are at your address in Prague: a hotel, an apartment or an office. Tell us the exact address when you book. Before the day you receive your chauffeur’s name and phone number, and on the day they wait at the door at the agreed time. A stop on the way, such as České Budějovice or Hluboká Castle, is not part of this trip; ask for a custom tour instead.
important_info:
Wear shoes for cobbles. Český Krumlov is steep in places and paved in stone throughout.

Castle interiors are closed on Mondays and in the winter months, though the courtyards, the old town and the views stay open all year. Theatre tours are best booked ahead in summer.

The old town is closed to cars, so you walk from the car park. It is a few minutes to the main square.

Lunch is easy to find on the river terraces below the castle. In July and August reserve a table, or eat a little early.

Your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide. Entrance tickets and guided tours are not included.

faq.q: How is the price worked out?
faq.a: There is one price for the whole car, set for each car class. It covers the drive there and back, fuel, motorway tolls and the hours at the destination included in your booking. You can add extra hours when you book, and you see the total before you pay.

faq.q: Does the chauffeur wait and drive us back the same day?
faq.a: Yes. The same car and chauffeur take you to Český Krumlov, wait for the time you booked and drive you back to your Prague address. Waiting during the hours in your booking is part of the price.

faq.q: What if we want to stay longer on the day?
faq.a: Tell your chauffeur. Time beyond your booking is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it, at the same extra-hour price you saw when you booked. Nothing is charged automatically.

faq.q: Is a guide or an entrance ticket included?
faq.a: No. The price covers the car and the chauffeur. Tickets and guided tours are booked separately, and the chauffeur does not act as a guide. We are glad to help you time the day around a guide or a ticket slot you have booked.

faq.q: Can we continue to Vienna, Salzburg or Hallstatt, or stay overnight?
faq.a: This page is for going there and back in one day. If you plan to stay overnight or continue to another city, book a one-way transfer on the Prague to Český Krumlov route, or ask us for a custom tour.

faq.q: How many people fit in one car?
faq.a: Up to three passengers in an E-Class or S-Class and up to six in a V-Class. Larger groups travel in two or more cars. Child seats are free in every class.

seo_title: Český Krumlov Day Trip from Prague — Private Car
seo_description: A private day trip from Prague to Český Krumlov with your own chauffeur: the castle and the old town, the car waits, and you are back at your door.
